pokedexEntries.ru: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this POKéMON give it the appearance of dancing.

pokedexEntries.sa: No two SPINDA are said to have identical spot patterns on their hides. This POKéMON moves in a curious manner as if it is stumbling in dizziness. Its lurching movements can cause the opponent to become confused.

pokedexEntries.frlg: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

pokedexEntries.em: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe’s aim.

pokedexEntries.dpp: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

pokedexEntries.hgss: The chances of two SPINDA having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

pokedexEntries.bw: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

pokedexEntries.x: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

pokedexEntries.y: The chances of two Spinda having identical spot patterns is less than one in four billion.

pokedexEntries.or: All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.

pokedexEntries.as: No two Spinda are said to have identical spot patterns on their hides. This Pokémon moves in a curious manner as if it is stumbling in dizziness. Its lurching movements can cause the opponent to become confused.

pokedexEntries.su: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it’s walking in a straight line.

pokedexEntries.mo: Each and every Spinda has a slightly different configuration of spots. There are collectors who enjoy the tiny differences in their spot patterns.

pokedexEntries.us: Its steps are shaky and stumbling. Walking for a long time makes it feel sick.

pokedexEntries.um: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

pokedexEntries.bdsp: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Their tottering steps hinder the aim of foes.
